user.title: Set up Home Messages
user.description: Configure iMessage and optional Sipgate SMS. Recipients and credentials can be changed later with Configure.

data_description.proxy_url: Base URL of the local proxy, including its port. Saving this form does not test connectivity or send a message.
data_description.proxy_api_key: Required at setup. When editing, leave blank to keep the saved key. Saved keys are never shown.
data_description.recipients: One ALIAS=+COUNTRYCODEPHONENUMBER mapping per line. Use an international phone number without spaces. Aliases are case insensitive and must be unique. Hyphens are reserved for groups.
data_description.sipgate_enabled: SMS fallback applies to single targets, including selections without a group binding, after a definite pre-send failure. Uncertain outcomes and configured group sends never trigger SMS.
data_description.sipgate_token_id: Required when SMS fallback is enabled. Leave blank when editing to keep the saved value.
data_description.sipgate_token_secret: Required when SMS fallback is enabled. Leave blank when editing to keep the saved value.
data_description.sipgate_sms_id: The SMS extension identifier from Sipgate, for example s0; this is not the recipient's phone number.
data_description.groups: Optional, for example BB-CC=chat_id:42. Use an existing proxy-allowed chat with exactly these members. Without a matching binding, members are sent individually. No chats are created.

error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS base URL with a host, without credentials, query parameters, or a fragment.
error.required_secret: Enter the iMessage proxy API key.
error.sipgate_required: This field is required when Sipgate SMS fallback is enabled.
error.invalid_recipients: Use one ALIAS=+internationalnumber per line (7–15 digits). Aliases start with a letter and may contain letters, digits and _ (up to 16 characters).
error.duplicate_alias: Each recipient alias must be unique, including after conversion to uppercase.
error.alias_hyphen_reserved: Hyphens are reserved for groups. Explicitly rename any existing recipient alias containing a hyphen and update its callers.
error.invalid_groups: Use ALIAS-ALIAS=chat_id:ID, one group per line. Each group needs at least two aliases and a positive integer chat ID.
error.unknown_group_alias: Every group alias must exist in the recipient mapping.
error.duplicate_group_recipient: Each group must contain distinct aliases with distinct phone numbers.
error.duplicate_group: Map each recipient group only once; a different alias order describes the same group.
error.duplicate_group_chat_id: A chat ID can be mapped to only one recipient group.

abort.already_configured: Home Messages is already configured. Edit the existing integration with Configure.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Home Messages integration can be configured.

init.title: Configure Home Messages
init.description:
Blank password fields keep their saved values. Changes apply after saving; the webhook address stays the same.

Local webhook URL (keep private):
`{webhook_url}`

POST form fields: `text` and `initials`. `BB,CC` sends individually. `BB-CC` uses its configured group; without a matching binding, it sends individually like `BB,CC`. Combine targets with commas.

send.name: Send message
send.description: Individual targets use iMessage with optional SMS fallback after a definite pre-send failure. Configured groups use iMessage only.

dry_run.name: Validate only
dry_run.description: Validate and preview effective destinations without sending. Missing group bindings appear as individual targets. No live membership or proxy permission checks.

initials.name: Recipients
initials.description: Commas separate targets. Hyphens select an exact configured group; without its binding, members are sent individually (BB-CC becomes BB,CC).

request_id.name: Request ID
request_id.description: Optional unique ID for this message. Reuse an ID only when retrying the same request.

test_connection.name: Test connection
test_connection.description: Read the iMessage proxy status without sending a message or SMS.
